full_judgment: 2. Facts, relevant for the purpose of disposal of the instant rule, in short, are that one Showkat Ara as informant lodged a written FIR with the local Kotwali Police Station, DRIP on 04.11.2008 alleging that she is the owner of a Pharmacy named Don Pharmacy at 144A, Nawabpur Road, Dhaka. Her husband Dr. Kazi Abu Yusuf purchased the possessory right of the Pharmacy in 1950 and had been owning the same. In the year 1986 by a deed of partnership her husband made her a partner of the said Pharmacy. Accused petitioner Md. Abdul Baqui had been working as an employee under the informant and her husband. Till before the death of her husband and her illness accused petitioner used to conduct the business of the pharmacy and maintained the trade license and other connected papers. On occasions he used to visit them in their residence and held discussion with them over business matters and paid them money for family expenses from the income of the pharmacy. Her husband expired on 19.03.2007. Since thereafter his visit to her residence became very thin. He also stopped giving her accounts of her pharmacy. She then asked him not to enter into the pharmacy premises but disobeying her instruction he continued to run the pharmacy as a trespasser. Accused petitioner Abdul Baqui and his son accused Reza fuel and accused Siddique Afroz Babul in collusion with one another created a forged deed of sale of the Pharmacy showing the same to have been executed by her husband in his personal pad on 07.06.2004. They also changed the name of Don Pharmacy into Kishor Medical Hall and created fake trade and drug license. When this matter came to her knowledge she apprised the relevant authority of the matter and they cancelled the forged drug license. When she went to the pharmacy and claimed ownership thereof they threatened her of murder. The informant made G.D. entry on 28.07.2007 and 26.07.2008. The accused petitioners misappropriated a sum of taka 5 lac from the sale-proceeds of medicine of the pharmacy. So, she lodged the FIR containing the aforesaid allegations whereupon Kotwali P.S. Case No.8 dated 4.11.2008 was started.
